Days & Months in Thai: 47 words with audio

Learn the days of the week, months of the year and how to talk about dates in everyday Thai.

วัน
wan
mid
Classifier; Noun
day, [classifier for days]
Remember it by
one
In a sentence
  • วันนั้นได้ครับ
    wan-nán dâai khráp
    That day works.\
  • วันนั้นไม่ได้ครับ
    wan-nán mâi-dâai khráp
    That day doesn't work.\
  • วันก่อนครับ
    wan-gɔ̀ɔn khráp
    The other day.\

Days & Months in Thai: 47 words with audio

This lesson teaches 47 Thai words for days & months in the Beginner part of the course, starting with วัน (day), วันจันทร์ (Monday), วันอังคาร (Tuesday), วันพุธ (Wednesday). Each word is shown in Thai script with tone colours, romanization and its English meaning, and you can hear it spoken at normal and slow speed.

Go through the cards at your own pace, then take the quiz to check what stuck. When you are ready, practise the same words in 279 example sentences.

Practise them in example sentences →
